name: A Sweet Meeting
source:
A boy encounters a random girl. But it turns out that she knew him since a long time ago! However, the boy doesn't recognize her.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/a_sweet_meeting]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩偶遇一名陌生女孩，却发现她很久以前就认识自己！然而，男孩并不记得她。

[译自[url=http://renai.us/game/a_sweet_meeting]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
